llm_proposer.assessment: The most likely cause is failure of the S15 ROADM WSS input port serving channels arriving from the S04 degree. It explains the simultaneous multi-channel OCH LOS and service/protection impacts, while unchanged S04→S15 amplifier and input-channel monitoring indicates that optical power still reached S15 and was blocked inside the ROADM.

proposals.rationale: Many channels and services failed simultaneously at t≈600 s, predominantly with receivers at S15 or farther downstream, while the S15 monitor on OMS S04-S15 and all amplifiers on that section saw no change. This strongly localizes the loss after the section monitor to the S15 WSS input port; the main caveat is that no explicit ROADM equipment alarm is reported.
